name: Murcielago and the Malecon
tagline: The city beach and the promenade behind it
description: The main beach and the seafront promenade that runs along it, with the hotels, restaurants and the highest concentration of visitor-facing business in the city. It is where Manta is at its most pleasant and where most short stays are based.
bestFor: Short stays wanting the beach and the promenade at the door
pros: Directly on the city's main beach
Restaurants and hotels along the promenade
cons: The most expensive part of the city
Busy at weekends with domestic visitors
Petty theft on the beach requires care

name: Barbasquillo
tagline: The newer residential strip west along the coast
description: The area west of Murcielago along the coast, with newer apartment towers, gated developments and a quieter beach below the cliffs. It is where much of the city's professional population and its small foreign contingent live.
bestFor: Longer stays wanting a newer flat with a sea view
pros: Newest apartment stock with sea views
Better security in the gated buildings
cons: A short drive from the centre

name: Tarqui
tagline: The old commercial quarter by the port
description: The historic commercial district beside the fishing port, badly damaged in the 2016 earthquake and only partly rebuilt. The fish market and the artisanal fleet are here, prices are the lowest in the city, and it looks and feels nothing like the beachfront.
bestFor: Budget stays and anyone drawn to the working port
pros: The cheapest accommodation and food in Manta
The fish market and the artisanal fleet
cons: Little in the way of services for visitors

name: Los Esteros
description: The neighbourhoods spreading east from the centre towards the tuna canneries and the industrial port, ordinary residential streets with local markets and the lowest rents in the developed part of the city. It is where most of Manta's workforce lives.
bestFor: Long stays at local prices with Spanish
pros: Local rents rather than beachfront ones
Close to the port and the canneries

name: San Mateo
tagline: The fishing village west of the city
description: A fishing village about fifteen minutes west along the coast, where the boats land on the beach and the seafood restaurants along the shore are the best value in the area. It is small, cheap and entirely local.
bestFor: Anyone wanting a village rather than a city, with a vehicle
pros: The best cheap seafood in the area
